records.summary: Semi-structured interview script and participant support protocol
records.plaintext: Use open questions, let participants skip any topic, and close by sharing support resources. Focus areas: (1) Transition to university workload, (2) Informal peer study networks, (3) Barriers to seeking formal academic or wellbeing support.

records.summary: Standardized coding tags and definitions for qualitative analysis
records.plaintext: Synthetic codebook: Theme A [PEER_SUPPORT] — peer study groups and studio check-ins; Theme B [WORKLOAD_SPIKE] — week 8-11 assessment clustering; Theme C [HELP_SEEKING] — hesitation to contact formal services before deadlines.
